claims.evidence: Witness reports visible wear, dust, scuffs, and chipped finish; table/stand has scratches and rust spots.
No clear view of motor/power cord and no stitching/operation test shown.
No proof of operation or included accessories shown.
Witness only confirms brand text “FLY”; no country-of-origin marking is reported as readable.
Motor condition is not shown; no power-on evidence in the report.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual.
claims.evidence: Accessories/manual are not shown in the witness observations.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No service history documentation or internal inspection shown.

risks.risk: Not actually working (motor/electrical fault, timing/feed issues).
risks.proof: A short video of the machine powered on with the motor running smoothly and a 1–2 minute stitching test on fabric (showing straight stitches and feeding).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-tested/possibly non-working sewing machine.

risks.risk: Wrong/unclear machine type (straight stitch vs zigzag/buttonhole) affecting value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the machine’s stitch selector/controls and the model/type label (or a close-up of the control panel and any markings).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest common value for an unknown/uncertain sewing machine type.

risks.risk: Missing parts or accessories (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power cord, manual).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo/video showing every included accessory and the manual, plus a close-up of the power cord and any foot pedal/controller.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete (no accessories/manual) and assume basic parts only.

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage may indicate heavier wear (chipped finish, scuffed bed, rusted stand).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area, feed mechanism area, and underside/hinges (showing rust, bent parts, or cracks).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst cosmetic/condition tier based on visible scuffs and rust.

risks.risk: Brand/country claim may be incorrect (e.g., not Japanese) which affects resale value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the serial/model plate and any country-of-origin label/stamp.

proof_requests: Power-on video showing the motor running and a short stitching test on fabric (straight stitch at minimum).
Close-up photos of the model/serial plate and any country-of-origin marking.
Photos/video of all included accessories (presser feet, bobbins, needles, spare parts) and the original manual (if present).
Clear photo of the power cord and any foot pedal/controller.
response.reason: The witness can identify the brand and visible condition, but the key value drivers (working status, exact type/model, and included accessories) are not shown. Without a power-on/stitching proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
